elevate.label: DM Consortium
head: Pakistan's Premier
Mountain Resort.
body: Founded by Fahad Masud Lone in 2018, DM Consortium has delivered over 15 landmark residential and commercial projects across Pakistan with unyielding commitment to architectural excellence.

Serene Heights Nathia Gali is the consortium’s flagship luxury mountain resort—spanning 30+ Kanals with 150+ bespoke residences, heated infinity pool, rooftop dining at 7,906 ft, Italian central heating, and 24/7 five-star hospitality.

footer.disclaimer: Every residence at Serene Heights Nathia Gali is operated within the resort's managed 5-star hotel programme: the building runs as a single hotel and residences are not let or operated outside it. The programme's terms, and any owner returns, are defined solely in the signed buyer documentation, which prevails over all marketing material. Rental income depends on occupancy, achieved room rates, operating costs and market conditions, all of which vary, and no return is guaranteed or represented in marketing. Registration of interest does not constitute an offer for sale, a reservation or a contract. Figures, specifications, dates and releases may change without notice.

ownership.label: A commercial asset
ownership.head: Own it. Earn from it.
ownership.lede: This is an income asset, not a second home. After handover Serene Heights operates as a single full service 5-star mountain resort, open all four seasons and staffed all year, and every one of the 150+ residences is run inside that operation by Serene Heights' own team. You hold the title and enjoy 28 free nights annual stay; the rest of the year it generates monthly rental returns of PKR 80,000 to 120,000.

returns.label: What it earns
head: It is not a second home.
returns.lede: Every residence is run inside Serene Heights' own 5-star resort operation, so it works all year rather than sitting shut for eleven months. The two numbers below are the ones that decide the answer: what a night sells for, and how full the building is. Both start where we expect to run them. Move either and watch the figure change.
returns.rateNote: Starts at Serene Heights' own planned nightly rate for this residence type.
returns.occNote: Starts at our planning figure of 60% of the year let.

rows.yield: Net yield on the starting price
rows.payback: Years to pay back the purchase

returns.crossover: At these assumptions the residence earns
returns.crossoverTail: what its own monthly instalment costs.
assumptions: Nightly rates start at Serene Heights' own planned operating card — PKR 70,000 for a one bedroom, PKR 160,000 for a two bedroom and PKR 250,000 for a three bedroom — and you can move them.

Occupancy is the share of the year let, starting at our planning figure of 60%. Serene Heights is staffed and open through all four seasons, including the winter snow season, when most of Nathia Gali closes.
Hotel management is 30% of gross room income, all in, and it is deducted in front of you in the table above. There is no separate owner service charge on top.
The purchase figure used is the published starting price for that residence type. A specific residence is priced individually, and those figures go to the founders’ list.
returns.caveat: Illustration only. These figures are produced from the inputs you set and are not a forecast, a projection, or any guarantee, offer or representation of return by Serene Heights Nathia Gali or DM Consortium. No rental return is promised. Actual income depends on occupancy, achieved room rates, operating costs and market conditions, all of which vary and may differ materially from the figures shown. The terms of the hotel programme, and any owner returns, are defined solely in the signed buyer documentation, which prevails over all marketing material.
